fields.description: Alton is NSHAMA’s one- to three-bedroom apartment development beside the upper end of Town Square Park. The developer describes views towards the park and central boulevard; the seven published layouts show how balcony space and room arrangements vary.

sources.label: Property Finder Alton project and pricing references

reviewCoverage.identity: Own Alton introduction and branded documents agree.
reviewCoverage.location: Own page places Alton beside Town Square Park, Dubai. Existing Town Square registry used; generic travel times and community metrics omitted.
reviewCoverage.residences: Own project introduction specifies 1–3 bedrooms. One 1BR, five 2BR and one 3BR plan families individually visually inspected.
reviewCoverage.areas: Seven official full drawings inspected. 2BR A printed minimum exceeds its maximum and component sums differ; exact printed columns retained without correction.
reviewCoverage.amenities: Named brochure page 18 visually inspected; seven project-specific features adopted without repeated generic community lists.
reviewCoverage.pricing: No official price list retrieved. Property Finder headline AED 1.3m conflicts with its AED 1.2m FAQ; headline price null rather than a guessed current entry price.
reviewCoverage.payment: Official one-page 50/50 schedule visually read: five 10% payments plus 50% handover. Historical fixed dates retained, not moved to today.
reviewCoverage.handover: Official payment sheet indicates May 2028, corroborated by Property Finder. No primary construction certificate/progress report retrieved.
reviewCoverage.documents: Official 28-page brochure, seven-page plans and one-page payment retrieved. Repeated brochure/plan layouts pooled with conservative combined PDF allocation 200; generic community derivation zero.

overview: Alton’s published plan pack makes the two-bedroom choices particularly easy to distinguish: five separate layouts are shown rather than one representative apartment.
The original payment calendar is useful background, but a new purchase requires a fresh unit quotation and its own contractual due dates.
research.locationNote: NSHAMA places Alton at the top of Town Square Park, with outlooks towards the park and central boulevard. Views depend on the individual home.
research.priceNote: No official price list retrieved. Property Finder displays AED 1.3m in its headline and AED 1.2m in its FAQ, alongside a sold-out label. These do not establish current developer stock or a reliable entry quotation.
research.paymentNote: Original launch calendar; request fresh contractual due dates.
research.handoverNote: Indicative developer target; not confirmed completion.
unresolved: 2BR A prints minimum 977.47 above maximum 977.36 sq ft; component sums differ approximately 1.83 sq ft. Confirm contractual areas.
Current stock, an official asking-price sheet, service charges and primary construction progress remain unverified.
The portal’s November 2025 booking dates are later than the official May 2025 launch calendar; portal start dates are not adopted.
